summary: Establish Model Governance Workspace + automate Slack role-sync and lifecycle for contractor access
description:
Issue summary:
Create a dedicated Confluence space and corresponding Jira project for the cross-functional Model Governance Council. Implement automated Slack channel provisioning and Okta-based role/group sync so that when a governance Jira project or meeting is created the matching Slack channel and Confluence permissions are provisioned automatically. Enforce contractor membership lifecycle: contractor access must auto-expire after 90 days unless renewed via a managed workflow.

Impact:
- Current governance notes, action items and review artifacts are scattered across personal pages and ad-hoc channels.
- Manual provisioning leads to inconsistent permissions and stale memberships (risk: sensitive model design docs exposed).
- ML Platform and Security have extra operational overhead for recurring manual offboarding.

Request details / requirements:
1) Confluence: create space "Model Governance Council" (space key: MGC). Default page templates: Meeting notes, Decision log, Model risk register, Rollout checklist. Permissions: read for engineering org, write for ml-platform-admins and select stakeholders. Space should be discoverable but restricted for editing.
2) Jira: create an internal-support project template "MGC Actions" with issue types: Action, Risk, Decision, Review. Default components mapped to ml-platform, research, privacy, security. When a new MGC Jira project is instantiated, trigger downstream automation (see #3).
3) Slack automation: implement a workflow that creates a channel following naming convention mgc-<topic>-<YYYYMM> (private by default), subscribes the Okta group mgc-<topic>-members, pins the meeting notes Confluence link, and posts a welcome message with owner and runbook link. Channels should be auto-archived after 365 days of inactivity unless an owner overrides.
4) Okta / Role sync: create and document Okta groups for MGC membership and role buckets (owners, reviewers, observers). Configure group-to-Slack provisioning and a periodic audit job that reports stale membership. Contractor groups must include a metadata tag and expiration timestamp.
5) Contractor lifecycle: implement a 90-day auto-revoke for contractor group memberships with an email notification 7 days prior to expiration and a renewal request workflow that requires manager + security approval. Track renewals in Jira automation.
6) Delegated admin: add ml-platform-admins to Confluence space admin and assign Jira project admin rights to the ML Platform Ops rotation group. Provide a short runbook for day-to-day ops and how to handle emergency access.
7) Observability & audit: wire Confluence and Slack audit logs to central logging (ELK) and add a daily digest for security with membership changes and channel creation events.

Acceptance criteria:
- Confluence space MGC exists with templates and ml-platform-admins have admin rights.
- Jira project template MGC Actions exists and includes the four issue types.
- On staging, creating a MGC Jira project successfully triggers Slack channel creation and Okta group provisioning in <30s during tests.
- Contractor membership created in Okta includes expiration metadata and triggers revoke job after 90 days in staging run.
- Automation code merged to org-automation repo with PRs listed in this ticket.
- Short runbook (<=2 pages) published to the new space and linked from the Slack welcome message.

Steps to reproduce / test plan (staging):
1) Spin up a test MGC Jira project using the new template in the staging environment.
2) Verify that a Slack channel named mgc-test-<YYYYMM> is created private and includes the welcome message and pinned meeting notes link.
3) Verify Okta group created and Slack membership synced within 60s.
4) Create a contractor user in Okta with 90-day expiration and run the revoke job; confirm membership removed and audit log entry created.
5) Confirm that automation logs show success and errors are reported to #internal-automation-alerts.

Runbooks / references:
- Confluence: Model Governance Charter (link above)
- Runbook for org-automation: https://github.com/redwood-inference/org-automation/blob/main/README.md
- Security checklist for spaces: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SEC/pages/987654321/Space+Security+Checklist

Notes / Constraints:
- Security requires approval from Security PM before granting write access to the broader engineering org.
- Okta provisioning to Slack requires Enterprise Grid configuration; coordinate with Identity team.
- Timeline goal: staging automation tests within 3 weeks, production rollout after Security sign-off.
